title: Lighter suspends all withdrawals after $10.4 million crypto exploit
reason: Major security breach on a decentralized exchange with specific financial impact and traced funds.

sources.summary: The decentralized exchange blamed a leaked trading API key and said its smart contracts were unaffected, while investigators traced funds to Hyperliquid.

title: Zelle picks Solana for ZelleUSD stablecoin and international payments
reason: Major adoption milestone as a dominant US payment network selects a blockchain for its stablecoin.

sources.summary: Zelle plans to use Solana for its ZelleUSD stablecoin and international payments, with confidential transfers designed to hide payment amounts.
